complexity_ledger.narrative: specs/tickets/MF-023/results/dogfood_decision.md -- MF-023 dogfooded the complexity scanner on tla-spec-dev's own model (bound 699,840, modularity Q=0.012, suggested move ABSTRACT, one advisory C1 warning, exit 0). No refactor was taken; the reasoning (no clean cut; the one abstract move buys no bound reduction and can only be validated by the discredited kill test) is recorded there. Complexity delta is ZERO vs MF-038 -- this is a docs-plus-optional-refactor ticket and no model changed. The substance is Deliverable 2: SKILL.md, references/modular_fuzzing.md, and references/architecture_tractability.md were rewritten to present the scanner as the shipped ADVISORY feature and to demote the modular-fuzzing / oracle / kill-test machinery to EXPERIMENTAL, not-validated-for-bug-catching, citing kill rate 0.31 / 0-of-9 and the Hypothesis-arm stub, and reconciling the older hard-gate / bug-catching text with the advisory reframe. The fuzzing oracles were deliberately NOT run as product validation, per the scanner-only reframe.

refinement.detail: The scanner (analyze complexity on this repo's model) emitted suggested move ABSTRACT -- project lastCommand and result, which no invariant reads -- plus one advisory warning that component C1 is touched by 14 actions (> cap 8), recommending a split of the densest state or moving the port-crossing actions behind a contract. Both candidates were considered and NOT applied. ABSTRACT yields zero state-space reduction (lastCommand/result are already unconstrained and excluded from the 699,840 bound) and the tool asks it be validated by the kill test, which MF-038 showed does not catch content bugs and which this ticket forbids running as validation. The C1/C2 decomposition is not taken: modularity Q=0.012 shows no clean cut, and cutting there routes 4 already- crossing actions through a contract, raising coupling. C1's density is the irreducible CLI shape (every command records its name + result). Recorded as a finding for the owner rather than refactored. Full reasoning: specs/tickets/MF-023/results/dogfood_decision.md

summary: MF-023: dogfooded the complexity scanner on this repo (advisory report recorded; suggested move ABSTRACT, modularity Q=0.012, one advisory C1 warning, exit 0); took no refactor with recorded reasoning; rewrote SKILL.md + references/modular_fuzzing.md + references/architecture_tractability.md to present the scanner as the shipped advisory feature and demote the fuzzing/oracle/kill-test machinery to EXPERIMENTAL not-validated-for-bug-catching, citing kill rate 0.31 / 0-of-9 and the Hypothesis-arm stub; zero TLA+ model delta.

assertions: SCANNER-ONLY REFRAME: assertions below replace the withdrawn decompose-everything criteria. The decomposition, corpus distillation, effect conformance, and kill test are NOT product validation and were deliberately not run as such.

analyze complexity is run on this repository's model and its advisory report recorded as evidence (scanner_report_baseline.txt / .json); it emits ABSTRACT as the suggested move and one advisory C1 warning, exit 0.

the Internal/External decomposition is treated as an optional recommendation: it was NOT taken, because modularity Q=0.012 shows no clean cut and the scanner suggested ABSORB not decompose; the decision and reasoning are recorded (dogfood_decision.md). No before/after scan is required because no refactor was taken.
zero TLA+ model delta: ticket current == desired; TLC green at 231,621 distinct / depth 25; max_distinct_states 500000 carried through desired/.

SKILL.md presents the complexity scanner as the shipped advisory feature and marks the fuzzing/oracle/kill-test machinery EXPERIMENTAL and not-validated-for-bug-catching, citing kill rate 0.31 / 0-of-9 and the Hypothesis-arm stub.

references/modular_fuzzing.md and references/architecture_tractability.md are reconciled so the advisory reframe and the fuzzing-experimental status do not contradict the older hard-gate / bug-catching text.
no product-validation run of the fuzzing oracles (corpus, effect conformance, kill test) was performed.
a reviewer reading only the new docs would expect the scanner to help and would NOT expect the fuzzing to catch bugs.

ticket.objective: SCANNER-ONLY REFRAME (owner decision 2026-07-21, after the MF-038 kill probe measured 0/9 content bugs caught and the owner chose to ship the complexity scanner and drop the fuzzing/case-advising story). Dogfood the COMPLEXITY SCANNER on this repository and write honest documentation. Run analyze complexity on this repo's model, produce the advisory report, and take the refactors genuinely worth taking (the Internal/External decomposition is a recommendation the scanner may emit, never forced, never a gate). Then make the docs honest: SKILL.md and references must present the complexity scanner as the SHIPPED feature (dimension table, bound, R/W matrix, modularity, dense-row detection, suggested moves, advisory warnings) and mark the modular-fuzzing / oracle / kill-test machinery as EXPERIMENTAL and NOT validated for bug-catching -- the kill probe caught 0 of 9 content bugs (kill rate 0.31, existence-and-exit-code oracles not content oracles). Do NOT run case generation, the corpus, effect conformance, or the kill test as product validation -- they are not the product. The point is a shippable, honestly-described scanner. See tickets/023-decompose-via-dogfooding.md and the ship-scanner decision in the epic notes.
